_meta.what: The complete intake map for ALL 25 axes. For each axis: which numeric series can feed it, which SDG/Eurostat catalog keys the traversal engine should walk, and - for the axes where no number can carry the meaning - which SEMANTIC sources must be read as text. This is the artifact that replaces 'the collector picks whichever axis sorts first in JSON key order'.
_meta.authored_by: Claude, from config/target_config.json (authoritative 25-axis list) + live probes

verification_discipline.rule: An entry marked verified=live_2026_08_03 was ACTUALLY FETCHED on that date and its extract path / column name was read off the real payload. Everything else is a NAMED CANDIDATE, not a source. It must be probed, its rule derived FROM the payload, and smoke-tested before it is ever offered for approval.
verification_discipline.why: a027 was rejected because it arrived with parse={} - a candidate with no parsing rule. This file exists so that never happens again: the map says WHERE to look; the probe says WHAT the payload actually is.
verification_discipline.never: Never promote an entry from this file to an active source without a real fetch. A name in this file is a hypothesis about the world, not a measurement of it.

reporter_independence_classes.independent: third party measures without the subject's control (instrument, satellite, expert coding, reconstruction from physical data)
reporter_independence_classes.self_reported: the measured entity produces the statistic (government statistical office, ministry, self-report aggregated by an international body)
reporter_independence_classes.mixed: third-party standardised, underlying counts supplied by the measured entity
reporter_independence_classes.adversarial: the reporter has an interest in the number being WORSE than the subject would report (opposition monitor, litigant, competitor, whistleblower)
reporter_independence_classes.unknown: not determined - never default to independent

_meta.independence_is_a_property_of_the_series: OWID is a re-publisher. An OWID URL inherits NOTHING. The class below belongs to the ORIGINATING measurement (V-Dem experts, Ember analysts, national police records), not to ourworldindata.org.
_meta.why_that_list_matters: target_config.json marks these axes primary_metric=null. That is not an oversight to be patched with the nearest available number. It is the config admitting that these axes are qualitative. They are precisely where SEMANTIC intake is required and where forcing a number would be the fabrication. Each such axis below carries semantic_sources and a what_no_number_can_capture note.

slots.measurement_daily: a number that moves at daily-or-faster cadence
slots.event_daily: discrete events (earthquakes, conflicts, outages) counted per period
slots.anchor_annual: the authoritative slow series the axis is scored against
slots.indirect_proxy: correlated but not the thing itself - must be labelled as proxy
slots.semantic_periodic: text read for meaning, not parsed for a scalar; produces a claim with provenance, never a silent number

That must be stated explicitly in the axis note or the axis lies by omission.
